styles.name: 极简知识信息图
styles.visual: flat vector geometric shapes, clear negative space, restrained palette and consistent line weights
styles.motion: build diagrams, connect modules, expand shapes
styles.avoid: fake exact labels or fabricated charts

styles.name: 手绘白板
styles.visual: textured pencil and marker strokes, off-white sketchbook, friendly rough edges
styles.motion: line draw, scribble reveal, erase and redraw

styles.name: 黏土 3D
styles.visual: tactile matte clay models, soft studio lighting, playful sculpted objects
styles.motion: squash, stretch, rotate and pop with coherent physical object identity

styles.name: 水彩绘本
styles.visual: paper grain, translucent watercolor washes, painterly silhouettes, warm quiet composition
styles.motion: pigment bloom, wash spread, brush reveal
styles.avoid: fast distracting cuts and fake text

styles.name: 像素动画
styles.visual: crisp pixel edges, limited retro palette, grid-aligned sprites
styles.motion: sprite step motion, tile build, discrete frame transitions

styles.name: 电影质感
styles.visual: cinematic lighting, deliberate composition, depth of field with realistic material
styles.motion: motivated slow dolly, focus change, object reveal
styles.avoid: unmotivated camera movement and identity drift

styles.name: 纸质编辑拼贴（可选）
styles.visual: editorial paper cutout textures, optional halftone photography and layered cardstock
styles.avoid: mandatory Vox-style half-tone or same solid-color background on every shot
